register.labelZh: DRY 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: dry off 可用來描述人或物件在游泳、淋雨、清洗或清潔後變乾的情況。；dry off 通常談及表面的水分;dry out 則可表示某物進一步失去水分,直至乾透。；dry up 可自然地表示金錢、工作、預訂或支援逐漸停止或不再出現。；在診所或治療情境中,dry out 可以表示接受戒酒治療。
register.summaryEn: Dry off helps you describe what people and things do after swimming, rain, washing or cleaning. Dry off usually concerns water on the surface, while dry out can describe something losing moisture more fully. Dry up gives you a natural way to describe money, work, bookings or support becoming unavailable. In a clinic or treatment context, dry out can mean receiving treatment to stop drinking alcohol.
